text:
martin: FYI deploybot blocked an unpin request for runtime=7.0 -> 6.9 because of a regional compliance flag affecting EU tenants. Opening thread to coordinate a safe path forward. :warning:

deploybot: unpin request detected: runtime=7.0 -> 6.9 scheduled for global canary. Blocked: region-policy=eu-datafreeze active. Suggested action: target non-eu cohorts or request exemption. Annot: "compliance-eu-datafreeze"

anya: what triggered the original unpin? Was it a regression signal or scheduled rollout?

martin: it was a scheduled unpin to resolve a tokenization drift in 7.0 for seqgen-pro that QA validated. We planned global canary->regional rollforward during change window at 04:00 UTC.

lee: legal just applied a temporary EU freeze for infra changes touching runtime versions after a customer audit. We can't change runtime on nodes that host EU-dedicated pools or multi-tenant infra marked eu-only.

legal: confirming. We need an exemption request with impact rationale and rollback plan before we touch EU host groups. ETA for manual review ~30m for critical fixes.

anya: options:
- A) reroute unpin to non-EU canary cohorts immediately (fast)
- B) submit legal exemption and wait for manual clearance (~30m) then unpin EU as well
- C) delay global unpin until next change window and keep EU pinned (low risk)

martin: since this addresses a tokenization drift that could cause misaligned tokens in production, I prefer option A for speed, then file exemption so we can include EU in the staged rollforward as soon as cleared.

lee: agree with A. We should ensure dedicated EU customers are untouched and add a feature-flag gate for the EU cohorts so legal can abort if needed. Also add TTL to rollback if anything goes sideways.

ops: note: rerouting canary cohorts requires specifying host groups. We have canary-non-eu-west and canary-non-eu-east available. Traffic volume lower but sufficient for validation.

martin: @deploybot please queue unpin to runtime=6.9 targeting canary-non-eu-west and canary-non-eu-east only. Add TTL=4h, annot "seqgen-token-drift-unpin", and set feature-flag "seqgen_unpin_non_eu"; do not target any eu-* host groups or dedicated-eu pools.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy unpin runtime=7.0 -> runtime=6.9 --targets canary-non-eu-west,canary-non-eu-east --ttl 4h --annot "seqgen-token-drift-unpin" --flag seqgen_unpin_non_eu
```

deploybot: starting unpin in 2m. Watch #eng-releases and #eng-runtime for progress updates.

anya: after unpin completes, run the tokenization regression and hash-compare test. Example repro:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-non-eu.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"seqgen-pro","prompt":"<longprefix>","seq_len":4096}'
# compare token hash output to golden
```

martin: support will notify enterprise contacts that EU pools remain on 7.0 until legal clears. We'll include the mitigation and ETA in the message.

deploybot: unpin progress: 3524680205 - canary-non-eu-west complete; 3524680280 - canary-non-eu-east complete. TTL set to expire at 3524683805.

ops: warmup completed and perf-smoke shows token hashes align with expected. p99 latency +0.1% on canary cohorts. No error spikes.

martin: good signal. @legal please advise on exemption timeline so we can plan EU rollforward. Also let's document this decision in the release notes as a partial-region rollout for safety.

legal: reviewing now. If you can provide the regression artifact, rollback plan, and contact list, we can usually clear within 20-30m for critical fixes. Please attach artifacts.

anya: uploading artifact to the ticket and pinging legal. Also filing follow-up to update the deploybot gating rules: add a compliance-aware target filter so future unpins can automatically exclude frozen regions unless explicit exempt=true flag is present.

martin: also adding a short release notes line: "Partial unpin of runtime 7.0 -> 6.9 for seqgen-pro in non-EU canaries due to tokenization drift; EU hosts remain on 7.0 pending legal review. ETA for full rollout TBD."

deploybot: noted. If legal approval arrives with explicit "exempt=eu-datafreeze" tag, we will attempt EU rollforward with a 2-step canary->regional gating.

legal: exemption granted at 3524680400 with condition: pre-rollout smoke >= 30m and support on-call present. Exemption tag: exempt=eu-datafreeze-3524680400.

martin: thanks. @deploybot please schedule EU rollforward to runtime=6.9 for canary-eu-west only, gated behind feature-flag seqgen_eu_unpin and require 30m smoke window. Annot "exempt=eu-datafreeze-3524680400" and TTL=6h.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy unpin runtime=7.0 -> runtime=6.9 --target canary-eu-west --flag seqgen_eu_unpin --pre-smoke 30m --annot "exempt=eu-datafreeze-3524680400" --ttl 6h
```

deploybot: EU rollforward scheduled to start after flag flip and pre-smoke condition. Watch this thread for completion.

ops: reminder to update runbook: add step to notify legal when auto-pin blocks due to region policy and how to request exemption. Filing PR for runbook now.

martin: closing immediate coordination — thread will remain open for deploybot status and legal confirmation. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
